content.user_title: Send Gmail Messages from the Command Line
content.value_statement: Preparing Gmail commands with recipients, content, copies, and attachments can be error-prone. This skill guides Claude and Codex through safe gws message sending.
actual_capabilities: Sends Gmail messages to one or more comma-separated recipients.
Supports plain-text and HTML message bodies.
Adds CC and BCC recipients when requested.
Attaches one or more files within Gmail size limits.
Sends from a configured alias or the default account.
Previews requests with dry-run or saves messages as drafts.
limitations: Requires the gws CLI and an authenticated Google Workspace account.
Attachments have a combined 25 MB size limit.
Sender aliases must already be configured in Gmail.
This skill does not read, search, or manage existing messages.

use_cases.title: Send a client update
use_cases.description: Prepare and send a clear status email with an optional report attachment.

use_cases.title: Draft an internal announcement
use_cases.description: Create an HTML announcement as a Gmail draft for review before delivery.

use_cases.title: Deliver generated reports
use_cases.description: Send scheduled report files to defined recipients with copies and a concise message.

prompt_templates.title: Send a simple email
prompt_templates.prompt: Send a Gmail message to [recipient] with subject [subject] and body [message]. Confirm the final details before sending.
prompt_templates.scenario: A beginner needs a basic plain-text message.

prompt_templates.title: Create a reviewed draft
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a Gmail draft to [recipients] about [topic]. Use subject [subject] and include these points: [points].
prompt_templates.scenario: A user wants to review a message in Gmail.

prompt_templates.title: Send a formatted attachment
prompt_templates.prompt: Prepare an HTML Gmail message to [recipient] with [file] attached. Use [alias] as sender and show a dry run first.
prompt_templates.scenario: A user needs formatting, an attachment, and an alias.

prompt_templates.title: Coordinate a multi-recipient delivery
prompt_templates.prompt: Prepare Gmail delivery to [to], copy [cc], and blind-copy [bcc]. Attach [files], validate the 25 MB limit, then request confirmation.
prompt_templates.scenario: An advanced workflow includes multiple recipient groups and files.

output_examples.input: Send Alice a short project update with the subject Weekly status.
output_examples.output: Ready to send a plain-text message to Alice with subject Weekly status. Final confirmation is required before sending.

output_examples.input: Draft an HTML launch notice for the operations team.
output_examples.output: Created a Gmail draft with an HTML launch notice for the operations team. The message remains unsent for review.

output_examples.input: Email the monthly report to finance and copy the controller.
output_examples.output: Prepared the finance email with the monthly report attached and the controller copied. Attachment size and recipients are ready for confirmation.

best_practices: Use dry-run to review recipients, sender, subject, and request details.
Confirm with the user immediately before sending any message.
Prefer drafts when content, recipients, or attachments need human review.
anti_patterns: Do not send messages without explicit user confirmation.
Do not expose recipients through CC when BCC is appropriate.
Do not attach sensitive files without verifying the path and intended audience.

faq.question: Does this skill send messages immediately?
faq.answer: It can send immediately, but it instructs the agent to request user confirmation first.

faq.question: Can it create drafts instead?
faq.answer: Yes. The draft option saves the message in Gmail without sending it.

faq.question: Can it send HTML email?
faq.answer: Yes. It supports HTML fragments when the HTML option is enabled.

faq.question: Can I attach multiple files?
faq.answer: Yes. Add the attachment option for each file, with a combined limit of 25 MB.

faq.question: Can it send from an alias?
faq.answer: Yes. The alias must already be configured as a Gmail send-as address.

faq.question: What setup is required?
faq.answer: Install the gws CLI, authenticate the Google Workspace account, and load the shared authentication guidance.
